# Design point P013

## Description

The system would replicate repositories across distinct racks for rack-level failure tolerance while reducing client command latency by omitting branch ahead-behind comparisons from status. However, adopting GVFS without the cache-server infrastructure required for its scalable request model conflicts with the scale objective and would leave that integration unsupported or ineffective.
